soresaki先生、こんにちは
前の絵は本当にありがとうございました！ とてもきれいなので、私の新しいOCでまたリクエストしたいです！

落ち着いて静かな彼女ですが、少女のような面のある、太ももが魅力的な彼女です。
彼女のシンボルは蝶です！ チョーカーと服に蝶の飾りが、耳にはイヤリングがあります！
そんな彼女の性格に合わせて、先生が彼女のポーズと構図を決めて描いてください！ 


よろしくお願いします！！
このイラストをTwitterなどのSNSに投稿したいと思います

soresaki様はじめまして！soresaki様の素晴らしい絵柄に惹かれ、今回リクエストさせていただきたいと思います。
もしよろしければ、下記のイラストを描いていただけますと幸いです。


このキャラは頭にはフード付きのマントを被っており、その上から猫耳が出ています。性格は落ち着いていて、静かな雰囲気です。
他には構図、配色、背景など全てお任せいたします。
デザインが変わっても問題ありませんので、お好きなように描いていただければ嬉しいです。
資料が少なくて申し訳ありません。


使用用途はアイコンや壁紙などの個人的な用途のみに使用させていただきます。


もしよろしければ、ご検討いただけますと嬉しいです。
資料が少なくて申し訳ありませんが、どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。

https://imgur.com/a/fK57Cp0

先生、こんにちは！シドロップと申します。先生の画風が絶対好きです！❤️
この二人のキャラクターを一緒に描いてほしいです。この二人のキャラクターはどちらも「ドラゴン娘」です！白いツインポニーテールの白いドラゴン娘は、激しい性格です。黒髪ロングの黒龍娘は温和な性格で、とても魅力的です。武器を持っているところも描いてほしいです。服装も自由に選んでいいし、新しい服をデザインしてもいい。
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/10BjLoKcFxv9yEjPTnGKXnEdyjVAq0o9T

だから、もし同じようなものがあればいいなと思っています。
このアートワークは個人的な使用と展示専用です。金額が足りない場合は再送させてください。もし私の依頼を受け入れていただけるなら、とてもありがたいです！♡

Hello soresaki, it's nice to meet you! I fell in love with your cool illustrations at first sight, thank you for always drawing nice pictures...! I hope you will draw my OC.

I don't need any movement or composition, so please play freely!

Intended use
Icons on social networking sites - iPhone wallpaper - May be printed for my own use and viewed at home, etc.


If there are any discrepancies in the amount or materials, I would appreciate it if you could request a resend!
Thanks!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/10_LNpy5gDFDffVJkX6-xqgvRy9aY02wn?usp=share_link

Hello! I would like a portait of a spider boy with a primarily white palette with dark blue accents. He's a scares a lot of people since he's a quiet archer who hunts monsters in the woods using his extra bug legs as a bow, but he's just very shy and is kind to the few friends he has.

 I've attached some of my rigs of him but the main features are his pink>orange gradient eyes and his four back spifer legs. Two curve over his shoulders, two curve below his waist. Apologies for the weird angles near their bases, the game I used to model him doesn't have proper bug legs so i had to use giant ahoge haha.

Thanks!

Hello soresaki sensei,
I really like your paintings,  very cute, can I request you to participate in drawing an illustration about my oc?
Please draw her with the whole body or on the thigh and draw her with the library in the background
The pose and composition are up to you but please give her サイハイソックス, not stockings like the reference
I'm really looking forward to your participation, thank you very much!
I would like to post this illustration on SNS such as Twitter


https://imgur.com/a/5qDbIib

Hi Sensei,

The previous illustration you did is so cute, I love it!!! I would like to request a video for my oc as well. 

My oc is a non-human girl with horns and long curly hair. Her existence is based on human’s pain, or it can be said that she is the concept of “pain” itself. Her themes include “flower of blood and flesh”, “painful”, “being a prisoner of her own mind”. Please feel free to draw anything you think suits her best! You can also adjust or simplify her clothing if it works better. 

You can find her detailed appearance in the attached link.

Thank you so much for reading this request, and I really appreciate your consideration. 

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1WvCC84lpiVWahpDmlE5elardOUwiE2Zt

Nice to meet you. I fell in love with your beautiful illustrations of the world and have been eagerly waiting for skeb to open.

I am preparing to become a Vtuber, and I would like to ask you to draw illustrations that can be used in videos, social networking sites, etc. I will leave the composition, poses, etc. to you.
The composition and poses are up to you. I would be happy if you could draw flowers and plants with me.

Character Details
https://lit.link/yuzukikoma
A wolf girl of unknown age.
She is curious, innocent and cheerful.
She loves human culture and travels alone, quietly crossing different places.
She harbors loneliness because she has lived for a long time.

As for the costume, we would like you to use the one from the material URL, but you may add your own arrangement.

Intended use
Use in Youtube videos
Dissemination on SNS such as X
Use as wallpaper or other return gift (for non-commercial purposes)
Your name, link, etc. will be posted when used.

We look forward to the opportunity to work with you.

https://toyhou.se/19076725.polaris/gallery#60774255

Nice to meet you! My name is Muno-chan, and I am an individual Vtuber.
I fell in love at first sight with the slightly dark, delicate and transparent illustrations of Mr. soresaki...! I would love to have you draw my character, Muno-chan.

Where to use
I would like to use it as a thumbnail for a social networking service or a YouTube video. I would appreciate it if you could add a psd (or PNG with transparent background) to your deliverables if possible.

▼Preferred image
We would like you to draw the image as you like from the following profile!

The design document will be a fixed image of the linked X. (You can use your imagination to draw the parts you can't see!)
Please leave the parts you don't know to us, and please do as much as you can ᴗ ᴗ ̫ ᴗ

Brief profile
Muno-chan loves cat-eared angelic creatures from outer space, retro games, horror, and donuts. Behind the scenes, she has a plan to rule people from the Internet. Usually, she is often in a daze. She laughs with an innocent look on her face. Under her apron is a school-like swimsuit.

Hello teacher! I would like to create a looping dynamic animation for my original character. This will be used as a dynamic wallpaper.

I want the scene to be in a library in the afternoon. I would like to depict the main character reading alone in a pile of books, turning the pages and laughing from time to time. I will leave the atmosphere and other elements of the environment up to you. You are also free to decide on the clothing and other aspects of the scene. For example, we leave it up to the teacher to decide whether or not the character should wear a hat. You are also free to change the details of the character's clothing.

Here is an image of the character: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1fiSaanV4Ed1_Av8msHmlmgY5iNrLuqCw/view?usp=sharing

Hello, soresaki-sensei!
 I'm sending a request because I really like soresaki-sensei's work and would like to commission her to draw my oc.
 Incidentally, I'm using a translator to communicate with you, so please understand that it may not make sense.
The URL is my oc's appearance and outfit, so please choose your favorite outfit to draw!
 Note that her hair is milky white, and that she doesn't make too drastic an expression.
 I'd like to leave the composition to the teacher's discretion!
 Thank you very much for seeing this to the end.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1gAGgMt7wKeXKGAZyFLctWqSBIvMrHLIA

Hello teacher! I really enjoyed the last painting you did for me, so I'm back to commission you again!

This time, I'd like to commission two different full-body character illustrations!

The reference is the same as before: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1g6QhJCxyehFKpjNbKt1NXLRRS3Ctt0O4/view?usp=sharing

As for the poses, I'll leave it up to you, but I'd like one of them to be in a pose where they're hugging their knees! These will be used for the song "後雨症" by 平葵. I also hope that if there's a background, it can be on a separate layer from the character. Additionally, please ensure that the canvas size does not cut off any part of the character; I want their body to be fully displayed! I had the same issue with the last full-body commission, so I'm wondering if it's possible to complete that as well.

Regarding the price, please adjust it based on the workload! I will respond as soon as possible.

Hello! Thank you for your time and illustrations!

If you have time and wish I'd like to request another illustration with a character for my game. 
It's Hatter, the Merchant and in the same time he is a powerful wizard and mechanic. He's very tall and a bit mad, but in the same time he know how to act like a normal person. He can endear people.

I think in an illustration he can sit like on a throne, in a white shirt instead of sweater, with majestic pose, maybe with one leg crossed over the other, with a bit threatening aura. With scrolls with letters bristling out of his sleeves. Maybe with a bit frowning and insidious expression on the mask. If you have other ideas - feel free to implement them.

Here are the references https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Xun7Fqx6Vf3axAyCQx_MwAcNkboEzLMF?usp=sharing

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Xun7Fqx6Vf3axAyCQx_MwAcNkboEzLMF?usp=sharing

Hi, I'm a newbie to the site and I'm looking forward to reading your illustrations. I love your illustrations!　I always enjoy looking at them.
I would love to see one of my favorite characters in your illustrations! I would like to see my favorite character in your illustration.
I will leave the background, composition, etc. to you.

◆Character
Manhattan Cafe" from "Uma Musume Pretty Derby
https://umamusume.jp/character/detail/?name=manhattancafe
Please use the design of "uniform" and "draft".

◆Brief introduction of her (for your reference)
Catchphrase: Mysterious girl who runs after invisible shadows.
She is good at making coffee.
She is always alone by the wall.
She can see things (ghosts) that people can't see.
She can see things (ghosts) that people can't. She always seems to have a "friend" by her side.
(Friend": A mysterious ghost that has been visible only to her since she was a child. (Friend: A mysterious ghost that has been visible only to her since she was a child, and looks very much like her.)
She is a girl who does not talk much and is often considered "eccentric" and "creepy" by those around her, but in reality she is a very sensible and age-appropriate girl.

Hello! I really love your artwork, so I'd like to commission a full-body illustration for my original character, to be used in a song!

The song is "後雨症" by 平葵.

Character images:
https://imgloc.com/image/Ba7fp
https://imgloc.com/image/BaOQT
https://imgloc.com/image/6zRdK

You can freely choose one of these three outfits for the character. I hope the illustration can capture the full body! You may also make some changes to the colors. I would like the character's pose and expression to be designed based on the feel of the song.

Since it's for a song illustration, I'd like multiple expressions for the character, though the pose can be the same. It would be great if you could add some small decorative elements! Additionally, I would like to receive the work in PSD format.

Hello, I am a fan of soresaki's illustrations!
I like soresaki's illustrations and I would like to request him to draw my character in FF14 if he would like.

The material of the character is as follows
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/17WWUl7dFwu5T-c520j6xVVh8PNZjVsEy?usp=drive_link

I leave the facial expressions and composition to soresaki.

If you are willing, I would be grateful for your consideration!
Thank you very much.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/17WWUl7dFwu5T-c520j6xVVh8PNZjVsEy?usp=drive_link

Nice to meet you! I was wondering if you could draw the characters that are in your materials.

Her hair is white and her inner color is light blue.
I like soresaki's drawing style, so I would like to leave everything to him, including the composition.

I would like to give the drawing to a distributor as a gift. I would like your permission to use it for distribution and on social networking sites.

Thank you very much.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-tIxZEojkwt2M9HHe7ulJ1RrTpunn-yJ

Hello! Thank you for your time and illustrations, I love them.

If you have time and wish I'd like to request another illustration with a character for my game. 
He is Jack - the one who knows a taste in sweet and candy magic. He isn't as simple as he looks at first glance. In fact, he is tricky and a bit manipulative. He is mostly calm. At the same time, he is a bit warm person.

He has a J-lolipop on his hat and hearts-candies on his boots. And reversed lollipop in his mouth for some reason.

Sometimes he makes a pathos impression. Like he overacts with his mysticism.
I think in an illustration he can be with some candy magic around him (like candy peaks, swirl or some other caramel stuff), with a comfortable pose, smiling, maybe with closed eyes. If you have other ideas - feel free to implement them.

Here are the references https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/13HRsv0DmaUq-oz19jnCh-v9lgXtAZ6Nm?usp=drive_link

Hello!
I really like your artstyle, and I would like to request a drawing of a cheerful Saigyouji Yuyuko.
Pose, composition, and drawing in general are up to you. Thank you very much for your consideration!

hi Soresaki! I have requested it from you before and I like it very much!

パソコンの壁紙のサイズ（3840×2160）はよかったです！

I want to request a wallpaper that I'm traveling in the Minecraft's 玄武岩の三角州 ( https://minecraftjapan.miraheze.org/wiki/%E4%B8%96%E7%95%8C/%E3%83%90%E3%82%A4%E3%82%AA%E3%83%BC%E3%83%A0#%E7%8E%84%E6%AD%A6%E5%B2%A9%E3%81%AE%E4%B8%89%E8%A7%92%E5%B7%9E_(Basalt_Deltas) ). Thanks very much! I really hope to see your work!

https://closed-lancer-774.notion.site/7268eac35b264494a98cfaa4c70f8111

Hello soresaki! Thank you for a great time at Comitia!
I heard that you opened a skeb and I would like to ask you to send me my OC's...
Please forgive me for resending this message due to an error in content...

Character:Muu Otonashi
Race:Dreamer
Characteristics:She is a spontaneous and elusive being. He is usually asleep and can put others to sleep with the power of a dreamer.
He has been adrift on a deserted island several times, and despite his appearance, he has a wealth of knowledge and experience in survival.
The pupils of his eyes are long and horizontal. As for family relations, she is the older sister of Milly Otonashi.

Character:Milly Otonashi
Race:Dreamer
Characteristics:She is a spontaneous and elusive being. She is usually asleep and can put others to sleep with the power of a dreamer.
He can transform into human form, but only the pupils of his eyes cannot be changed, and they are long and horizontal.
In terms of family relations, she is the younger sister of Otonashi Mu.
Whether she is in a dream state or a human state is up to you. She floats around in fluffy air and basically wears no shoes. (She walks around in her human life, such as going to school, or in front of other people, as if it is a pain in the ass.)
You can draw her wearing a coat when she is a human, or taking off her coat when she is a dreamer, and so on.

Situations
The sister Otonashi Muu looks sleepy!
We will leave the details of the composition to soresaki-san. It would be helpful if the background and characters are separated.

Intended use
Personal viewing, icons on SNS, etc., introductions on your own wiki with the author's name clearly written.
We are planning to use it as a standing picture in a game in which you are participating.

■Materials
OTONASHI Mu
https://oinarisama.wiki.fc2.com/wiki/%E9%9F%B3%E7%84%A1%20%E3%83%A0%E3%82%A5
OTONASHI Milly
https://oinarisama.wiki.fc2.com/wiki/%E9%9F%B3%E7%84%A1%20%E3%83%9F%E3%83%AA%E3%82%A3

Hello, I really like the paint and atmosphere of soresaki's illustrations, so I would like to make a request.
I would like to commission you to draw my original character if you would allow me to do so.

Character:
She is a book-loving and knowledgeable human girl.
She is modest, quiet, and kind-hearted.
She can use simple magic to make one object float.
She has black hair, wears an ivory hat with a necklace and two red hairpins.

Reference: https://photos.app.goo.gl/Bg7hwJve2QFvgDjG8

A book would be nice to have as an item. Other poses and compositions are up to you.
I like illustrations with blank or plain expressions, so I would appreciate it if you could keep that kind of atmosphere.

The purpose of this work is for personal viewing.
Thank you very much for your consideration.

https://photos.app.goo.gl/Bg7hwJve2QFvgDjG8

Hello! Thank you for your last illustration, it's awesome, I really enjoy it. 

If you have time and wish I'd like to request an another illustration with a character for my game. She is a half ghost witch-necromancer Eliza. She's cold, indifferent, dreamy, absent-minded, moony, but in a good mood in general. She likes to play with people and she's a slightly out of her mind.

The "wings" that she has are mostly used to attack and can become arbitrary sized. I think at the illustration she could casting some spells with this ghost aura around her. If you have other ideas - feel free to implement them.

Here are the references https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xXv9UfUuocbX7qjgCin0xyL0rcwWFneZ
